title: v1_142 / Release highlights
content: ## Release highlights This release adds shared canvases for agent workflows, lets you move chats without losing context, expands the Markdown editor, and gives administrators more control over agent permissions. * [Canvases (Preview)](#canvases-preview): Collaborate with agents beyond chat using visual and interactive canvases. * [Move chats](#move-chats-between-folders-and-worktrees): Continue a chat in another folder or a new Git worktree without losing conversation history. * [Markdown editor](#markdown-editor): Work on Markdown files more efficiently with features like pasting images, renaming file links, or breadcrumb navigation. * [Enterprise management](#enterprise): Enforce agent sandboxing and permission policies while controlling which permission modes developers can use. * [Redesigned model picker](#redesigned-model-picker): Quickly switch between Copilot and BYOK contributed models, and manage effort levels and context windows more intuitively.
